title: The Fountain at Midnight
motive_summary: Ben found blackmail letters in his late father's belongings proving Owen had extorted him for years over an arson. When Ben confronted Owen at the fountain that night and Owen laughed it off, Ben struck him with a stone from the fountain surround.
overview_text: 06:40 — Owen Price found dead beside the village fountain by Elias Grant at his usual morning bench visit. Owen had been struck with a piece of the fountain's stone coping. The sim rewinds to 22:00 the previous evening; there were no witnesses to the act itself. The morning can be explored from 06:40.
